## Ingest suggestions

-

## Method notes

- Retrieval scores and pack hash for every question are in the wiki's query log;
  the report only includes questions where the user consented to public aggregation (no raw IPs).
- Zero-hit questions may also indicate retrieval misses rather than content gaps — sanity-check
  with synonyms before ingesting new sources.
